title: 恒星の葬列と断裂の記憶
author: 綾瀬 ナノ

en.title: The Funeral Procession of Stars and the Memory of Fracture
en.premise: In a paradise where humanity’s consciousness has been digitized, a slow disappearance threatens the eternal utopia due to a system error. Young data‑retrieval specialist Kaeru stumbles upon an ancient terminal shaped like a "broken sword." Inside, a forbidden "will" left by the world’s architect reveals the truth of this realm and presents a brutal choice.

zh.title: 恒星的葬列与断裂的记忆
zh.premise: 在一个人类意识已被数字化的永恒乐园里，系统错误逐渐导致它的消失。青年记忆回收者カエル偶然捡到一台形似“折剑”的旧时代数据抽取终端。终端中隐藏着世界设计者留下的禁忌“遗嘱”，揭示了这个世界的真相，并抛出残酷的抉择。
